config.script:
vfdPath = self.view.params.vfdPath

    activePath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/Active"
    ownerPath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/Owner"
    appliedAtPath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/AppliedAt"
    reasonPath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/Reason"

    resetRequiredPath = "[default]vLock/Default/System/ResetRequired"
    vfd101RunPath = "[default]vLock/Default/VFDs/VFD-101/Cmd_Run"
    vfd102RunPath = "[default]vLock/Default/VFDs/VFD-102/Cmd_Run"

    activeValue = bool(
        system.tag.readBlocking([activePath])[0].value
    )

    # Prevent applying the same LOTO again.
    if activeValue:
        return

    root = self.getParent().getParent()

    reason = str(
        root.getChild("ReasonInput").props.text or ""
    ).strip()

    username = str(
        self.session.props.auth.user.userName or ""
    )

    equipmentName = str(
        self.view.params.equipmentName or ""
    )

    if not reason:
        system.perspective.print(
            "LOTO reason is required."
        )
        return

    results = system.tag.writeBlocking(
        [
            activePath,
            ownerPath,
            appliedAtPath,
            reasonPath,
            resetRequiredPath,
            vfd101RunPath,
            vfd102RunPath
        ],
        [
            True,
            username,
            system.date.now(),
            reason,
            True,
            False,
            False
        ]
    )

    if not all(result.isGood() for result in results):
        system.perspective.print(
            "LOTO tag write failed: " + str(results)
        )
        return

    try:
        system.db.runNamedQuery(
            "vLock/InsertLOTOEvent",
            {
                "equipment_name": equipmentName,
                "action": "APPLY",
                "username": username,
                "reason": reason
            }
        )

    except Exception as error:
        system.perspective.print(
            "LOTO applied, but database logging failed: "
            + str(error)
        )

vfdPath = self.view.params.vfdPath

    activePath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/Active"
    ownerPath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/Owner"
    reasonPath = vfdPath + "/LOTO/Reason"

    values = system.tag.readBlocking([
        activePath,
        reasonPath
    ])

    isActive = bool(values[0].value)
    reason = str(values[1].value or "")

    if not isActive:
        return

    username = str(self.session.props.auth.user.userName or "")
    equipmentName = str(self.view.params.equipmentName or "")

    # Release the LOTO first.
    system.tag.writeBlocking(
        [
            activePath,
            ownerPath,
            reasonPath
        ],
        [
            False,
            "",
            ""
        ]
    )

    # Logging failure must not prevent the release.
    try:
        system.db.runNamedQuery(
            "vLock/InsertLOTOEvent",
            {
                "equipment_name": equipmentName,
                "action": "RELEASE",
                "username": username,
                "reason": reason
            }
        )
    except Exception as error:
        system.perspective.print(
            "LOTO released, but database logging failed: " + str(error)
        )
